reviews.text: Cristina, the veterinarian, is wonderful, we are very happy. Natalia is another wonderful one, and what can I say about Miriam, my dog ​​Kira's groomer, she makes her look adorable. A top-notch team, thank you!
It's an apartment building; I visited a friend there. The apartments are comfortable and close to several bus stations, making it easy to get around and near various shops and restaurants.

I wholeheartedly recommend Cristina.

She has treated all of our family's pets with complete dedication. We had Rinxols with oral cancer, and there was little that could be done, but she stayed with us until the very end, making his life easier.

She was just as professional and kind with Chispeta. She not only treated him when necessary but also recommended supplements based on his specific needs at any given time.

In addition to being professional, Cristina has such empathy for animals that we knew our pets were in good hands with every visit.

They're the vet for my three cats, and I couldn't be happier. Especially after the last incident, when one of my cats jumped off the balcony, and Cristina and the team attended to him immediately, making room for me at the last minute between appointments they already had scheduled. They treated my cat with so much love and without charging us an arm and a leg.
Grateful doesn't even begin to cover it!
I didn't like the lack of clarity in the fees and the extra cost per treatment
Ccveterinaria is synonymous with professionalism, exquisite attention and above all the treatment towards my pets has been excellent.

I took my 14-year-old dog, who has arthritis, after warning him that he was having difficulty and was likely to get nervous. When I picked him up, they told me he'd had a terrible time, that he'd been very agitated, and that they'd even had to bathe him again. I understand that he might get stressed; he does it everywhere. That's why I asked if I could stay nearby or if they could call me if anything happened, and even then, there were no alternatives.

What I found completely unacceptable was that they literally told me that "two groomers and an hour and a half of bathing isn't profitable for them." That makes it clear that money comes first here, not ethics or the well-being of an older animal.

They suggested I take him somewhere else with a drying booth, but the reality is: if your dog is easy to bathe, great; if he has any difficulty, it's best not to take him, because here they only care about profitability.

I won't be going back, and I don't recommend it to anyone looking for professionalism, empathy, and truly careful treatment of senior animals.
A completely trustworthy veterinary clinic. I've been taking my dogs there for years, and Cristina and Natalia's care and expertise are excellent. Highly recommended.

Fantastic staff!!! Veterinarian Cristina and her colleague treated my dog ​​wonderfully. We went for the first time to update my dog's vaccinations, as we were going on a trip and he needed to have his vaccinations up to date in his passport. It was our first time at this clinic and we'll definitely be back! My little dog is very timid and didn't even realize he was getting two vaccines. You can tell they care about making sure the animals are comfortable and that it's not a cold and traumatic experience. We left very happy; we're so lucky to have this clinic close to home for any emergency. Thank you so much, ladies!!!
They just want to make money...they'll sell you things your pet doesn't even need, there's no passion for pet ownership anymore.
